name: TWL
recent: TWL Holdings 于2026年11月宣布以2600万令吉收购位于吉隆坡的 Wisma TWL，该交易属关联方交易。同期，公司董事及主要股东 DATO' TAN WEI LIAN 及其关联方在公开市场持续买卖股份，并有一批 RCULS 转换的新股于11月24日上市。
notable: RCULS 转换发行的450,000股新股于2026年11月24日上市。
risks: Wisma TWL 收购属关联方交易，卖方与主席有关联。
公司再次就未经事先同意的 ESOS 授予寻求批准，此次涉及主席夫人。
董事及主要股东在11月多个交易日出现持股变动。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为6269万令吉，环比增长192.6%，同比增长205.4%；净利为183万令吉，环比下降49.8%，同比下降92.3%，净利率为2.9%（上季为17.0%）。

recent_en: TWL Holdings announced in November 2026 the acquisition of Wisma TWL in Kuala Lumpur for RM26 million, a related-party transaction. Meanwhile, director and major shareholder DATO' TAN WEI LIAN and related parties continued trading shares in the open market, and new shares from RCULS conversion were listed on 24 November.
notable_en: Proposed acquisition of the 9-storey shop/office building Wisma TWL at Jalan Melaka, Kuala Lumpur for RM26 million.
Director DATO' TAN WEI LIAN bought 910,000 shares in the open market, raising total stake to 1.61 billion shares.
450,000 new shares from RCULS conversion were listed on 24 November 2026.
risks_en: The Wisma TWL acquisition is a related-party transaction with a seller linked to the chairman.
The company is again seeking approval for ESOS grants made without prior consent, this time involving the chairman's wife.
Director and major shareholder shareholding changes occurred on multiple trading days in November.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM62.69 million, up 192.6% QoQ and 205.4% YoY; net income was RM1.83 million, down 49.8% QoQ and 92.3% YoY, with a net margin of 2.9% (previous quarter: 17.0%).
